study_design: Case-control study conducted in two towns of Serbia (Yugoslavia) from 1990 to 1994, with hospital controls individually matched to prostate cancer cases.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A case-control study, performed in two towns of Serbia (Yugoslavia) from 1990 to 1994, comprised 101 patients with histologically confirmed prostate cancer and 202 hospital controls individually matched by age (+/-2 years), hospital admittance and place of residence.
reason: The abstract analyzes histologically confirmed prostate cancer without reporting stage, grade, metastatic status, lethal disease, or another aggressive endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: According to logistic regression step by step analysis, risk factors for prostate cancer were dietary intake of retinol equivalent (OR = 1.64, 95% CI = 1.01-2.67) and vitamin B12 (OR = 1.87, 95% CI = 1.15-3.05), and a protective effect was found for dietary intake of iron (OR = 0.40, 95% CI = 0.27-0.58).
estimate_classifications.reason: The retinol-equivalent estimate concerns prostate cancer generally; no aggressive subtype is specified.
